# Beauty Clinic Mallorca

> Aesthetic / anti-aging clinic in Bendinat, Mallorca (Spain). Lead practitioner: Dr. Erik Koerge. Public site: https://beautyclinicmallorca.com/

## Confirmed facts (from public site + NAP confirmed by owner)

- Name: Beauty Clinic Mallorca
- Address: Calle Arquitecto Francisco Casas 17, Plaza Bendinat Local B10, 07181 Bendinat, Illes Balears, Spain
- Phone: +34 971 707 725
- Email: info@beautyclinicmallorca.com
- Hours (site copy): Monday–Friday 09:30–18:00
- Location notes (site copy): Plaza Bendinat; free underground car park; ~5 minutes from Palma, ~20 minutes from Andratx
- Practitioner: Dr. Erik Koerge — wrinkle injections / anti-aging focus; site states 15+ years clinic / 20+ years experience in the field
- Products mentioned on site: Allergan Juvederm fillers, Botox / Vistabel; Filorga Laboratories (mesotherapy); Profhilo (Ibsa Farmaceutici) for mini-lifting
- Languages on site: English (https://beautyclinicmallorca.com/) and German (https://beautyclinicmallorca.com/index-de.html)

## Services mentioned on the public site

- Botox / wrinkle injections
- Dermal fillers (Juvederm)
- Mesotherapy
- Skin rejuvenation / anti-aging / facelift without surgery concepts
- Treatments aimed at skin quality, texture, facial contour, and skin tightening
